description.text:
The Happy Set Trainer's Pokémon (宝可梦卡牌 嗨皮组合 训练家的宝可梦) came out on 16 October 2026, the sixth Happy Set, built on the Trainer's Pokémon that Chasing Glory brought in. Like the others, it is a box for two to four friends, new players or old hands, to play together. It held four new ready-to-play 60-card decks, each with a card explaining how it plays. Team Rocket's Mewtwo ex can attack only with four or more Team Rocket's Pokémon in play, and Team Rocket's Spidops' Ability attaches Energy from the discard pile to itself. Cynthia's Garchomp ex has one attack that draws cards and one that hits hard, Cynthia's Gabite's Ability finds Cynthia's Pokémon, and Lucario's attack strikes back if one of its player's Fighting Pokémon was Knocked Out during the opponent's last turn. Misty's Gyarados gets its big attack from Misty's Psyduck on the Bench, with Sacred Ash and Super Rod putting Misty's Pokémon back into the deck. Ethan's Typhlosion hits harder the more Ethan's Adventure cards are in the discard pile, and Ethan's Quilava's Ability finds an Ethan's Adventure. With luck one of the four decks was a holo deck, the same cards in holo, which turned up 1.6% of the time.

The box also held a beginner's guide, two battle guides, damage counters and two coins, rules for two to four players, a 10-card modification pack for strengthening a deck between games, a one-card reward pack, shared out by the results, and seven two-card Happy Packs (嗨皮包), shared out by the number of games won. A Happy Deck (嗨皮卡组) box holding one of the four decks at random came out the same day. Its cards are numbered out of 54; five basic Energy, Fighting, Fire, Grass, Psychic and Water, print their type code instead of a number.
